rules: Never enlarge matching distances after seeing validation locations.
Locations with uncertainty >25 m support regional coverage analysis only, not entrance-localization claims.
Report central, possible and robust uncertainty-region coverage separately.
Compare geology-only, terrain-only, original landscape, morphology-only and combined indices at equal area budgets.
Report full-study and comparable-geology denominators; zero scores cannot create artificial high-rank coverage.
Inventory absence is not confirmed cave absence; historical exploration is biased.
Related entrances and spatially clustered records are not independent evidence.
No supervised model or geographic expansion without credible independent predictive evidence.
